title: Lake Mereldar

[[Image:Lake Mereldar.jpg|thumb|Lake Mereldar]]
[[Lake Mereldar]] is a large lake in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]], located south of [[Corin's Crossing]].  This polluted water body is infested by corrupted [[water elemental]]s.
